findings.source_passage: As if the waves had been fullers, this craft was bleached like the skeleton of a stranded walrus.
findings.why_it_matters: The source opens a new paragraph with this striking simile, giving it rhetorical prominence; in the draft it is collapsed mid-sentence into a long run-on with em-dash phrasing, dissolving the sentence's distinctive punch and the deliberate paragraph break that frames the spectral ship description.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore this as its own sentence or at minimum preserve the paragraph break so the simile retains its rhetorical isolation.

findings.source_passage: They seemed clad in the skins of beasts, so torn and bepatched the raiment that had survived nearly four years of cruising.
findings.why_it_matters: The vivid 'clad in the skins of beasts' image — with its archaic, almost biblical register — is the signature phrase of the look-out description; the draft reduces it to 'bepatched by four years' cruising,' dropping the beast-skins comparison entirely and stripping the passage of its interpretive resonance (the men made feral by long voyaging).
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'clad in the skins of beasts' verbatim or in close paraphrase before 'bepatched.'

findings.source_passage: though, when the ship slowly glided close under our stern, we six men in the air came so nigh to each other
findings.why_it_matters: The 'six men in the air' detail is interpretively significant — the precise number, the suspension in air, and the utter silence despite closeness — and is flattened in the draft to 'so near we might almost have leaped,' losing the aerial isolation and the specific 'six' that emphasises human proximity against cosmic indifference.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'six men in the air' and the phrase about the ship gliding 'close under our stern' to preserve the spatial and symbolic specificity.

findings.source_passage: it almost seemed as though he would have lowered a boat to board the stranger, had not the threatening wind forbade
findings.why_it_matters: The source's conditional subjunctive ('it almost seemed as though he would have lowered') carries Ahab's suppressed compulsion; the draft converts this to a flat past conditional ('he had almost lowered'), slightly dulling Ishmael's observational irony about Ahab's barely-restrained impulse.
findings.suggested_fix: Minor: preserve 'almost seemed as though' phrasing to keep the narrator's speculative register.

summary: No high-severity signature losses; three medium findings centre on the erasure of 'clad in the skins of beasts,' the collapse of the spectral-ship opening paragraph, and the loss of 'six men in the air,' all of which flatten the chapter's most evocative imagery without crossing the regeneration threshold.
